clue.text: Credit note returned — it may secure admission

parts.note: a tick is informal British for credit, as in buying on tick

indicators.note: returned means the note's letters are read backwards

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A credit slip is handed back; perhaps it gets you in somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: TICK for credit is British slang, as in buying 'on tick'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pass bought for an event or journey is what grants you entry.

clue.text: Poor quality marble, lacking interest

parts.note: a taw is a large marble used for shooting
dry writing is dull, lacking interest

explanation.surface: A dull piece of marble stonework of shoddy workmanship.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap and showy goods are tacky, of poor quality.

clue.text: Country actor sharing top role in cinema appearance first of all

parts.note: a co-star shares top billing with another actor

indicators.note: first of all takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: An actor sharing the lead appears on screen first.
explanation.definitionFit: The Central American republic between Nicaragua and Panama is a nation.

clue.text: Remove European plane holding 100

indicators.note: holding means the plane's letters go round the hundred

parts.note: a jet is a kind of plane
C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: Taking off a European aircraft carrying a hundred passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw out or expel someone is to put them out by force.

clue.text: Referring to group's moral principle, going round North

indicators.note: going round means the principle's letters surround the compass point

parts.note: an ethic is a moral principle

explanation.surface: A group's moral code travelling about the North.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to a people or cultural community.

clue.text: Two articles on time about plays

parts.note: the and a are the definite and indefinite articles
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Two newspaper pieces about the timing of some dramas.
explanation.definitionFit: Drama as an art form, the staging of stage works, is called by this collective word.

clue.text: Point: cake's been brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a bun is a small cake

explanation.surface: The key issue: somebody has been sick after eating cake.
explanation.definitionFit: The crux or gist of a matter is its central point.

clue.text: Indefinitely postpone siting of new Church in California

indicators.note: in means the new church letters are placed within the state abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Plans to build a new church in California are shelved.
explanation.definitionFit: To call something off is to postpone it with no date set.

clue.text: Where Times may end up — finding water pipe bans out of order?

indicators.note: out of order means the letters of the three words are jumbled

explanation.surface: A plumbing ban gets declared out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' is this newspaper itself, read and then discarded.
explanation.definitionFit: Old newspapers such as The Times are thrown in the office rubbish basket.

clue.text: Fruitful source — a very quiet let, really excellent earnings initially

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quiet
taken as written

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: A peaceful rental property brings in excellent income.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard plant that bears pippins is literally a fruit-bearing source.

clue.text: Severely criticize meat dish

definitions.meaning: to slate or pan someone harshly
a joint of beef cooked in the oven

explanation.surface: A critic savages a meat course.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for harsh criticism and a noun for an oven-cooked joint.

clue.text: Though briefly accepted by European, unsatisfactory road feature

indicators.note: accepted by means the shortened word goes inside the European

parts.note: a Pole is a European, from Poland

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short, losing its final letters

parts.note: though is often shortened to the informal spelling tho

explanation.surface: A European grudgingly accepts that the road is in poor condition.
explanation.definitionFit: A hole in a road surface is a hazard for drivers.

clue.text: Once hit in crash, vulnerable

indicators.note: crash means the letters of the three words are smashed up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Having once been hit in a collision, one feels exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes being in a precarious, risky position.

clue.text: Carry out pitchfork maybe

definitions.meaning: to put a plan into effect
a pitchfork is an example of a tool

explanation.surface: Someone told to take away a farm fork.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to execute; as a noun it means a tool, of which a pitchfork is one.

clue.text: Anger professional with very satisfactory English

parts.note: pro is short for professional
OK means satisfactory

explanation.surface: Irritating a pro whose English is quite good.
explanation.definitionFit: To anger someone is to incite or enrage them deliberately.

clue.text: Some hide ale, ruining trader

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people conceal beer, spoiling it.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchant who buys and sells goods is a trader.

clue.text: Kind of gene, extremely typical inside

indicators.note: inside means those two letters go within the word gene
extremely takes the outermost letters of the word typical

explanation.surface: A kind of gene that is extremely typical inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind of gene' looks like one phrase, but 'Kind' alone is the definition, an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind person is mild and tender in manner.

clue.text: Charm of unusual name associated with us

indicators.note: unusual means the letters of name are arranged in a different way

parts.note: our means belonging to us

explanation.surface: The appeal of a strange name linked to ourselves.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to captivate them, making them fall in love.

clue.text: Inducement gets tribe to change leader

indicators.note: to change leader means the first letter of tribe is swapped for a different one

explanation.surface: A tribe is offered an incentive to replace its chief.
explanation.definitionFit: A payment offered to corrupt someone is an inducement.

clue.text: Seaman in sub? No, transferred

indicators.note: transferred means the letters of these words are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A sailor in a submarine refuses to be moved.
explanation.definitionFit: The boatswain is a ship's officer in charge of equipment and crew, a seaman.

clue.text: Get dressing down as result of gambling disaster?

definitions.text: Get dressing down as result of gambling disaster?

parts.words: Get dressing down as result of gambling disaster?
parts.note: the idiom for losing everything after a bad bet, read literally, means being stripped of a garment

explanation.surface: Getting a telling-off after a disastrous bet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing down' looks like a scolding but literally means undressing.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to lose all one's money, typically through gambling.

clue.text: Higher after second drink?

indicators.note: after means the word for higher follows the letter for second

parts.note: up means higher

explanation.surface: A question about having another drink after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: To sip or take liquid in small mouthfuls is to drink.

clue.text: Charge that is right for sword

parts.note: a rap is a criminal charge, as in a murder rap
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: An accusation that it is right to carry a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin, sharp-pointed blade used for thrusting is a type of sword.

clue.text: Queen by eastern extension

parts.note: Anne was a queen of Great Britain
x is the times sign, read as by in dimensions such as four by six

explanation.surface: A queen has a building put up beside the eastern wing.
explanation.definitionFit: A building added on to a larger one is an add-on wing.
